notes: Requires two approved pools, executable-quote TWAP, liquidity/impact caps, cross-pool comparison, and multiplication by independently derived XTZ_USD. Empty pools are not wildcards. No one-pool degraded mode. Derivation is USDtz/XTZ TWAP x XTZ_USD (not USDtz/USDT): USDtz/USDT pools (Spicy Stable, Plenty, Quipuswap v3) were evaluated and rejected -- either unverifiable cumulative encoding (Spicy: price_cumulative_0/1 is ~34 orders of magnitude smaller than a standard Uniswap-V2 UQ112.112 accumulator would be; Plenty: no amplification coefficient or oracle exposed) or negligible real liquidity (CoinGecko 2026-09-01: USDTZ 24h volume $0.81). Two independent USDtz/XTZ pools were verified on-chain via TzKT 2026-09-01, both plain constant-product AMMs with real, active liquidity and NO built-in cumulative-price oracle: Quipuswap v1 USDtz/XTZ (tez_pool/token_pool reserves, ~124,232 XTZ / ~32,935 USDtz) and Dexter USDtz/XTZ (xtzPool/tokenPool reserves, ~6,906 XTZ / ~1,829 USDtz, different protocol/creator/code hash -- genuinely independent). Spot prices from the two pools agreed within ~0.1% at verification time. Because neither pool publishes its own TWAP, the validator samples each pool's raw spot price (xtz_reserve/token_reserve) itself over time and computes a linear time-weighted average locally -- this avoids re-deriving any protocol's internal fixed-point math entirely. Numeric thresholds below are provisional pending liquidity/risk review sign-off; adapter wiring into derive.ts remains a separate implementation step.
instrument_definition: USDtz/USD via locally-sampled TWAP(USDtz/XTZ, Quipuswap v1 + Dexter) x XTZ_USD
